verdict.rationale: Granola documents a built-in in-meeting disclosure: it posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts so all participants know. This sits within a dedicated 'transparency solutions' section of its consent/privacy docs, which is a real product feature rather than a policy document. The evidence is a single short mention. missing for 10: evidence of admin-enforced or workspace-mandated transparency settings, detail on which meeting platforms and modes (e.g., in-person/mobile) get the disclosure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Granola posts a message in your meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know.
